# QCrypton PQC Proxy — Hybrid Post-Quantum TLS Dashboard

TLS handshake telemetry across PQC Proxy instances. Tracks hybrid PQC adoption, downgrade events, certificate health, and connection metrics. Data source: `PQCProxy_CL`.

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize Count = count() by QuantumPosture
| render piechart
content.title: PQC adoption — handshake posture distribution

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize Count = count() by NegotiatedGroup
| order by Count desc
| render piechart
content.title: Negotiated key exchange groups

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize PQC = countif(QuantumPosture == 'pqc-hybrid'), Classical = countif(QuantumPosture == 'classical'), Downgraded = countif(QuantumPosture == 'downgraded') by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: PQC vs classical handshakes over time

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'downgrade'
| summarize Downgrades = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ProxyHost
| render timechart
content.title: PQC downgrade events over time

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize Total = count(), PQC = countif(QuantumPosture == 'pqc-hybrid'), Classical = countif(QuantumPosture == 'classical'), Downgrades = countif(QuantumPosture == 'downgraded'), AvgLatencyMs = round(avg(RequestLatencyMs), 2) by ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId
| extend PQCPct = round(100.0 * PQC / Total, 1)
| project ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId, Total, PQC, Classical, Downgrades, PQCPct, AvgLatencyMs
| order by Total desc
content.title: Per-proxy summary

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where EventType == 'cert_expiry'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProxyInstanceId, CertPath
| project ProxyHost, CertPath, DaysRemaining = round(CertExpiryDays, 1), LastReported = TimeGenerated
| order by DaysRemaining asc
content.title: Certificate expiry status

content.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType in ('tls_error', 'upstream_error')
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Error events over time
